target.title: fix(googlechat): cap two warn-once Sets via createDedupeCache
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes unbounded memory growth in two Google Chat warn-once deduplication Sets. Both `warnedDeprecatedUsersEmailAllowFrom` and `warnedMutableGroupKeys` accumulated every warned key forever with no eviction, TTL, or size cap.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced both unbounded `Set<string>` instances with `createDedupeCache({ ttlMs: 0, maxSize: 4096 })`, imported from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/dedupe-runtime` per extension boundary policy. The `check()` method provides touch-on-read LRU semantics.

## User Impact

No change for gateways handling fewer than 4 096 distinct warned keys per cache.

## Evidence

### Real-path validation — existing tests exercise both warning paths in the actual module

The existing 13 `monitor-access.test.ts` tests pass with the patched module. Both warning paths are exercised through the real `logVerbose` callback:

- `warnMutableGroupKeysConfigured` is called for every group policy check, using `warnedMutableGroupKeys.check()`
- `warnDeprecatedUsersEmailEntries` is called when deprecated `users/email` entries are found in `allowFrom`, using `warnedDeprecatedUsersEmailAllowFrom.check()`

```text
$ pnpm vitest run extensions/googlechat/src/monitor-access.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ googlechat inbound access policy > does not match group policy by mutable space displayName...
 ✓ googlechat inbound access policy > fails closed instead of falling back to wildcard when a deprecated room key matches...
 ... 13 passed (13)
```

The `"does not match group policy"` test triggers `warnMutableGroupKeysConfigured` with a deprecated group key. The verbose output shows `deprecated mutable group key detected` only once — the module-level `warnedMutableGroupKeys.check()` deduplication is exercised through the real runtime path.

### Cache cap and LRU eviction

`createDedupeCache({ ttlMs: 0, maxSize: 4096 })` is the same helper used by Telegram and Slack. Cache cap and LRU behavior are verified by unit tests:

```text
$ pnpm vitest run src/infra/dedupe.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ createDedupeCache > keeps entries indefinitely when ttlMs is zero or negative
 ✓ createDedupeCache > touches duplicate reads so the newest key survives max-size pruning
 ... 5 passed (5)
```

### Plugin boundary contract passes

```text
$ pnpm vitest run src/plugins/contracts/plugin-sdk-package-contract-guardrails.test.ts

 ✓ keeps extension sources on public sdk or local package seams  ... 22 passed (22)
```
